meta.source: ELC logo masters (D:\elc-vids\elc-logo-assets) and the website redesign canvas, 31 Oct 2026; contrast checked to WCAG 2.2

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Logo blue. Primary buttons, links, active states, blue sections. White text on it is 11.4:1; as text on white, 11.4:1.

tokens.name: blue-deep
tokens.usage: Footer, portal sidebar, hover and pressed state of blue. White on it is 14.8:1.

tokens.name: blue-mid
tokens.usage: Secondary blocks inside blue sections (LIVE weekday chips, video placeholders). White on it is 8.8:1.

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: Alternate section background, quiet cards, selected table rows. Ink, muted ink and blue all pass on it.

tokens.name: blue-tint-strong
tokens.usage: Image placeholders, progress track, avatar background. Muted ink on it is 7.1:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative card borders and dividers only (1.3:1, not for controls).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, chips and secondary buttons on white (3.1:1).

tokens.name: line-on-deep
tokens.usage: Input borders on blue-deep (footer), 3.6:1.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and card background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface or blue-tint (19.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, help text on surface (8.5:1) or blue-tint (7.9:1).

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blue, blue-deep, blue-mid and red.

tokens.name: on-blue-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on blue (8.5:1) and blue-deep (11:1).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The logo star and red fills (LIVE badge, Express button, Subscribe) with white text (4.6:1). Never red text, never red on blue (2.5:1).

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Red words: eyebrows, step numbers, WhatsApp keywords, required stars, urgent deadlines. 6.1:1 on white, 5.7:1 on blue-tint.

tokens.name: red-tint
tokens.usage: Background of New and overdue badges, with red-text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Text of Open, Paid and Saved messages, on success-tint (5.9:1).

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background for success badges and the Saved banner.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Text of Opening soon, In review, Started, Sample data, on warning-tint (5.9:1).

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background for warning badges.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Background for Closed and Hidden badges, with ink-muted (7.4:1).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text, tight badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, label to input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button groups, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gaps, field gaps, small card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page side padding, card padding, step gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large card padding, form padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between hero columns, section heading to content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section top and bottom padding on desktop (48px on phones).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Portal inputs, small tags, table controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Website inputs, steps, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, service tiles, panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Feature panels, hero image frames, CTA bands.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, chips, filter tabs.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating price card on the hero.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Header dropdown menus.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: Sticky phone action bar.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: white gap then blue ring; visible on white and on blue.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Below this: header collapses to a menu button and the phone action bar appears.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum content width; 24px side padding.
